name: custoro
description: Self-hostable invoicing and worksheet app (API + web)
author: Ingmar Ross <dooker@dooker.eu>

scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/api && npm run lint --prefix apps/web
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix apps/api && npm run type-check --prefix apps/web
scripts.check-all: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run build
